Visa Rejection and Travel Insurance Coverage

A visa application fee was paid, but the visa was subsequently rejected. The coverage raises the question of whether travel insurance can assist in such situations, specifically detailing the concept of 'fraudulent payment card cover' which addresses unauthorized financial losses incurred if a payment card is lost or stolen and used before being reported.
